name: MenuItem

props.name: dangerDescription
props.description: Specify the message read by screen readers for the danger menu item variant

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether the MenuItem is disabled or not.

props.name: kind
props.description: Specify the kind of the MenuItem.

props.name: label
props.description: A required label titling the MenuItem. Will be rendered as its text content.

props.name: renderIcon
props.description: A component used to render an icon.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Provide a shortcut for the action of this MenuItem. Note that the component will only render it as a hint but not actually register the shortcut.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon MenuItem rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
